title: Define and measure operating-layer service objectives
goal: Measure availability, task success, queue delay, inference latency, and recovery duration from actual events; publish windows and denominators with explicit unknowns when samples are insufficient. Deps (vectors): VC-201-003, VC-201-030, VC-201-091. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_092_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
